test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Uncomfortable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate option** to fill in blank number 2 is** "uncomfortable."**
 
• Swelling in the joints **can be** very **uncomfortable.**
 
• **When there is fluid in the tissues **around the joints, it can cause pain, stiffness, and limited mobility.
 
• The **discomfort** can make it** difficult to move **the affected joints and can significantly impact daily activities.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: * It can be very **uncomfortable **and can make it difficult to move the affected joints.*
